name: Orc no Yabou ~Shiikusareru Onna Yuusha-tachi~
original_name: オークの野望～飼育される女勇者たち～
source:
-----His evil lord was conquered. 
At the same time the orcs were slaughtered, and extinction loomed. 
By some miracle Gongo survived. 

The last orc found a village of girls, captured it, and created a farm to breed his slaves. The priority was to breed, and breed he will. 
Firstborns will be raised to powerful orc warriors...... 
A new army will rise, led by Gongo......! 

Will Gongo defeat the heroes and build a new empire? 
Or will he be hunted and killed like a common monster? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE180557.html]DLsite English[/url]]
